source_baseline.note: Caelen repository seal plus five disclosed external zero-credit activation-route failures, each with a separate bounded recovery.

method_flow.reason: A duplicate combined projection would exceed the 100000-word per-document ceiling; every atomic witness remains present in one named shard.
method_flow.boundary: Same-owner finite exact synthetic software evidence only. No empirical, participant, professional, production, deployment, legal, cultural, Maori-authority, affected-party, privacy-complete, accessibility-complete, exhaustive-security, independent-reproduction, AGI/ASI, consciousness/personhood, Theory-of-Everything, canon, or Stage 20 credit. NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20.

operational_failures.failure: The first memory-registry probe used the parent memory directory instead of the actual memories/MEMORY.md registry and found no file.
operational_failures.recovery: Resolved the documented memories/MEMORY.md literal path and performed one bounded keyword pass.

operational_failures.failure: The first read-only skill inventory wrapper piped directly from a foreach block and PowerShell rejected the empty pipeline element before reading a skill.
operational_failures.recovery: Materialized the bounded inventory rows before projecting them.

operational_failures.failure: A combined multi-skill read exceeded its bounded output and truncated before every selected skill reached literal EOF.
operational_failures.recovery: Read each required skill separately in bounded complete projections.

operational_failures.failure: The first broad handoff line window truncated because a small number of source lines were exceptionally long.
operational_failures.recovery: Used smaller contiguous windows and verified the committed EOF sentinel.

operational_failures.failure: The first compact Caelen JSON projection retained inherited arrays and exceeded its output budget.
operational_failures.recovery: Selected only exact scalar counts and named keys.

operational_failures.failure: A second compact source projection still emitted nested portfolio arrays and truncated.
operational_failures.recovery: Used targeted scalar-only projections and independent recursive JSON parsing.

operational_failures.failure: The first raw v15 workflow display omitted middle assignments and could not prove sequence continuity.
operational_failures.recovery: Parsed the complete JSON locally and checked all 210 contiguous ordinals.

operational_failures.failure: A mixed PowerShell and cmd temporary-file manifest probe was rejected by host policy before execution.
operational_failures.recovery: Used a read-only Node Git-blob stream and PowerShell-native cleanup-free scalar probes.

operational_failures.failure: The local tracking ref observed earlier was absent when rechecked even though the live remote still advertised the exact final.
operational_failures.recovery: Fetched only the named Caelen source branch into its matching remote-tracking ref.

operational_failures.failure: An ancestry query ran before the missing source object was refetched and returned an ambiguous-revision failure.
operational_failures.recovery: Repeated the bounded ancestry query only after the exact source fetch exited zero.

operational_failures.failure: The first sparse no-checkout worktree projection retained an empty index, so Git status presented inherited paths as staged deletions before any commit.
operational_failures.recovery: Populated the exact source index with git read-tree -mu HEAD; only the Orin owner directory remained untracked and no inherited blob changed.

operational_failures.failure: The first planning serialization used pretty JSON and measured 193346 whitespace-delimited words, above the 100000-word document ceiling.
operational_failures.recovery: Preserved the same parsed plan semantics in deterministic compact JSON, recorded the failed precommit projection, and rebuilt the planning manifest.

operational_failures.failure: The first successful x1 result was serialized as pretty JSON and measured 144738 whitespace-delimited words, above the 100000-word document ceiling.
operational_failures.recovery: Preserved the exact parsed x1 semantics in compact JSON, retained the oversized digest and word count, rebuilt the x1 manifest, and did not replay x1 execution.

operational_failures.failure: The first no-write final budget preflight asserted the aggregate ceiling before emitting its scalar per-document projections, so it exited nonzero without identifying the oversized component in its output.
operational_failures.recovery: Retained the nonzero diagnostic, emitted scalar sizes before the gate, and kept any full Method Flow or negative ledger in separately sealed files rather than duplicating an oversized structure.

operational_failures.failure: The first read-only final completeness projection normalized Windows relative paths with a two-backslash literal and falsely reported owner and delta manifest incompleteness.
operational_failures.recovery: Normalized each path by splitting on the platform separator and verified that the final owner manifest has no missing or extra path.

operational_failures.failure: The next read-only delta projection trimmed the complete porcelain stream, stripping the leading worktree-status space from its first record and falsely dropping the first path character.
operational_failures.recovery: Preserved record-prefix whitespace and compared the exact staged path set with the delta manifest without whole-stream trimming.
